record.body:
## Evidence

Execution report for status-tabs: 5 tabs, keys 1-5, no left/right binding, no README change reported. Work-item description: 7 tabs, keys 1-7, left/right on the tab row, footer and README updated. Acceptance text does not name Waiting, All or left/right, so the criterion passes.

## Consequence

Delivered behavior is narrower than the description. Waiting tasks sit inside Active only. There is no All tab.

## Follow-up

Decide: accept 5 tabs, or add a small follow-up for Waiting, All, keys 6-7, left/right and README.
